mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of S&P 500 earnings, leading to positive forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Fed to delay rate hikes or initiate cuts, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in a 3-year walk-forward test (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the likelihood of a Fed rate cut, thereby lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a negative or insignificant coefficient in a multivariate regression (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 over two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which may trigger a policy response from the Fed to stimulate growth, reducing real rates and increasing equity valuations, resulting in positive forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal shows no predictive power in a 3-year walk-forward test (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflationary pressure, which increases the probability of a Fed rate hike, raising discount rates and reducing the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high CPI periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 500,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST > 1150 thousand units), indicates strong private demand, which may delay or prevent Fed rate cuts, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of high RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100k and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 3.9%) signals labor market weakening, which increases the likelihood of Fed intervention to stimulate growth, lowering real rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of weak PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to generate positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized over the past six months signals a weakening economy, which increases the probability of a Fed rate cut, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of low GDPC1 growth (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
